code_sha_note: merge commit f4d29e66 of backlog/leak-null-2026-11-03 into feat/data-capture-and-risk (the pinned code commit)

decision_rule.R0: INVALID (HELD stands) on any of: level-0 invariant |CRPS(M0prime)-CRPS(M3)| > 1e-9 on rows with levels[M3]==0; fold-disjointness defect (AC10); N3 M0prime != N1 M0prime row for row (> 1e-9); prefix_level changed by scramble or plant; positive control not flagged (AC11); < 18 completed seeds in any null; prereg digest or code pin changed.
decision_rule.R1: L_N2 > 0 and M_N2 >= 0.005 -> LEAK_CONFIRMED (GAP-1 PASS withdrawn to UNRESOLVED-LEAK; #10 held). L_N2 > 0 and M_N2 < 0.005 -> HELD_INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.R2: L_N1 <= 0 and N1 per-seed positives <= 2/20 and n_completed_N1 == 20 -> DISCHARGED_FLUKE; uses completed-seed bounds only.
decision_rule.R3: L_N1 > 0, L_N2 <= 0, M_N2 <= 0.25*M_N1, L_N3 > 0, M_N3 >= 0.5*M_N1 -> DISCHARGED_BENIGN_DOF.
decision_rule.R4: L_N1 > 0, L_N2 <= 0, M_N2 <= 0, and AC12 passes -> DISCHARGED_PENALTY_MEDIATED (pipeline clean; sufficiency not shown).
decision_rule.failed_seeds: FitNotConvergedError marks (seed,null) failed with reason; counts as non-positive with denominator K=20; excluded from M_N/sd/n.
decision_rule.order: R0 then R1 then R2 then R3 then R4; anything else -> HELD. Every discharge requires R0 to pass. L_N = M_N - t*sd/sqrt(n), t=2.093 at n=20.

one_look_note: One look only: no successor study on INVALID / HELD / HELD_INCONCLUSIVE / R4 (L-34); J3 result.json and GAP-1 PREREG never edited.
